draft.name: aki_creatinine_rise_0_3_within_48h
draft.sql: WITH cr AS (SELECT l.hadm_id, l.charttime, l.valuenum FROM labevents l JOIN d_labitems d ON d.itemid = l.itemid WHERE d.label = 'Creatinine' AND d.fluid = 'Blood' AND l.valueuom = 'mg/dL' AND l.valuenum IS NOT NULL AND l.hadm_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT a.hadm_id FROM cr a JOIN cr b ON b.hadm_id = a.hadm_id AND b.charttime > a.charttime AND b.charttime <= a.charttime + INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND b.valuenum - a.valuenum >= 0.3
assumptions: Serum creatinine is identified by d_labitems label 'Creatinine' with fluid 'Blood', so no itemids are hard-coded.
Only creatinine results recorded in mg/dL (valueuom = 'mg/dL') are used.

A rise is any pair of measurements within the same admission where the later charttime is strictly after the earlier one and no more than 48 hours later, and the later value minus the earlier value is >= 0.3; the rise is not measured against a rolling minimum baseline.
Rows with NULL valuenum or NULL hadm_id are excluded.
labevents.charttime is taken as the time of the creatinine measurement.
No restriction is applied to ICU stays or to the timing of the measurements relative to admission or discharge.
Output is one row per qualifying admission (DISTINCT hadm_id).

draft.name: aki_kdigo_48h
draft.sql: WITH cr AS (SELECT l.hadm_id, l.charttime, l.valuenum FROM labevents l JOIN d_labitems d ON d.itemid = l.itemid WHERE d.label ILIKE 'creatinine' AND d.fluid ILIKE 'blood' AND l.hadm_id IS NOT NULL AND l.valuenum IS NOT NULL AND l.charttime IS NOT NULL AND (l.valueuom IS NULL OR l.valueuom ILIKE 'mg/dl')) SELECT DISTINCT b.hadm_id FROM cr a JOIN cr b ON a.hadm_id = b.hadm_id WHERE b.charttime > a.charttime AND b.charttime <= a.charttime + INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND b.valuenum - a.valuenum >= 0.3
assumptions: Serum creatinine is identified by d_labitems.label ILIKE 'creatinine' with fluid ILIKE 'blood'; no hard-coded itemids are used.
Creatinine values are taken as mg/dL; rows with a unit other than mg/dL are excluded, while rows with a NULL unit are kept.
Any two creatinine measurements in the same admission qualify as a pair, with the later one (b) at most 48 hours after the earlier one (a) and strictly after it.
The rise is computed as later value minus earlier value and must be >= 0.3 mg/dL; a fall or a rise measured across a window longer than 48 hours does not count.
Baseline is the earlier measurement in the pair, not a pre-admission or pre-ICU baseline, because the text does not specify one.
Only labevents rows with a non-null hadm_id are considered, so the result is limited to rows that can be tied to an admission.
The urine-output criterion is excluded, as stated in the reference.
DISTINCT returns each qualifying hadm_id once.

draft.name: patients_with_diabetes
draft.sql: SELECT NULL::BIGINT AS hadm_id WHERE false
assumptions: The methods text names the population as patients with diabetes but gives no diagnosis definition for diabetes: no ICD-9 or ICD-10 code list, no diagnosis-sequence rule, and no lab or medication alternative. Without these, the criterion cannot be computed without inventing codes.

The stated age (at least 18 years), ICU stay (at least 24 h) and finger-stick glucose (at least seven measurements within a 24-hour ICU stay) criteria are separate inclusion rules and do not define diabetes.
The finger-stick glucose measurements cannot be mapped to chartevents or labevents itemids from the text, so that rule would also need an itemid list if it were implemented.

Missing to compute the criterion: a diabetes ICD code list (versions 9 and 10), or an explicit alternative definition such as glucose or HbA1c thresholds or diabetes medications, with any required time window.

draft.name: KDIGO creatinine-rise AKI (>=0.3 mg/dL within 48 h, same admission)
draft.sql: WITH cr AS (SELECT l.hadm_id, l.charttime, l.valuenum FROM labevents l JOIN d_labitems d ON l.itemid = d.itemid WHERE d.label = 'Creatinine' AND d.fluid = 'Blood' AND l.valuenum IS NOT NULL AND l.hadm_id IS NOT NULL) SELECT DISTINCT a.hadm_id FROM cr a JOIN cr b ON a.hadm_id = b.hadm_id AND b.charttime > a.charttime AND b.charttime <= a.charttime + INTERVAL 48 HOUR AND b.valuenum - a.valuenum >= 0.3
assumptions: Serum creatinine is identified via d_labitems with label = 'Creatinine' and fluid = 'Blood' (e.g., itemid 50912); valuenum is assumed to be in mg/dL, the standard MIMIC-IV unit for this item.
A 'rise' means a later measurement minus an earlier measurement is >= 0.3 mg/dL. Any earlier value in the window may serve as the baseline, not only the admission minimum or first value.
'Within 48 hours' means the later measurement is strictly after the earlier one and at most 48 hours after it (inclusive at 48 h).
Both measurements must carry the same non-null hadm_id. Lab rows without hadm_id are excluded.
Rows with null valuenum are ignored. No plausibility filtering of creatinine values is applied.

draft.name: aki_kdigo_48h
draft.sql: WITH cr AS (SELECT l.hadm_id, l.charttime, l.valuenum FROM labevents l JOIN d_labitems d ON l.itemid = d.itemid WHERE lower(d.label) = 'creatinine' AND lower(d.fluid) = 'blood' AND l.valuenum IS NOT NULL AND l.hadm_id IS NOT NULL AND (l.valueuom IS NULL OR lower(l.valueuom) = 'mg/dl')) SELECT DISTINCT b.hadm_id FROM cr a JOIN cr b ON a.hadm_id = b.hadm_id AND b.charttime > a.charttime AND b.charttime <= a.charttime + INTERVAL 48 HOUR WHERE round(b.valuenum - a.valuenum, 6) >= 0.3
assumptions: Serum creatinine is identified through d_labitems as label 'Creatinine' with fluid 'Blood' (itemid 50912 in MIMIC-IV). Creatinine measured in other fluids, such as urine, is excluded.
Values are taken as mg/dL. Rows with a different non-null unit are excluded, and rows with a null unit are kept.
The rise is measured from any earlier creatinine value to any later value in the same admission. Both values are linked by labevents.hadm_id, and lab rows without a hadm_id are ignored.
The later value must be strictly after the earlier one and at most 48 hours later (inclusive of exactly 48 hours).
The difference is rounded to 6 decimals before the >= 0.3 comparison. This avoids floating-point errors, for example 0.7 - 0.4 being evaluated as slightly below 0.3.
The urine-output criterion is not applied, as the specification states.

draft.name: Patients with diabetes (Ye H, et al. 2025)
draft.sql: SELECT NULL::BIGINT AS hadm_id WHERE false
assumptions: The methods text says only 'patients with diabetes'. It does not say how diabetes was identified.
No ICD-9/ICD-10 code list is given (for example 250.x or E10-E14), and it does not say whether diagnosis position or ICD version matters.
No lab-based definition is given, such as an HbA1c or glucose threshold, and no medication-based definition is given, such as insulin or oral hypoglycemic prescriptions.
No time window is given for when the diabetes evidence must be recorded (index admission or any prior admission).
Implementing the criterion would require inventing a code list or threshold, so it is not computable as stated.
The other criteria (age >=18, ICU stay >=24 h, >=7 finger-stick glucose values within 24 h) are outside the requested task and were not implemented.
